pages.title: Idols
pages.text: Idols are magical artifacts used to influence the world in focused ways, from shifting the weather to cleansing cursed items. All idols are formed from a Silk Idol and refined herbal materials.

pages.title: Weather Idols
pages.text: Weather idols are activated by holding their power for a moment, allowing them to alter the skies and surrounding atmosphere.

pages.title: Rainfall Idol
pages.text: Calls rain upon the world for a time, making it useful for crops, ambience, and weather-dependent effects.

pages.title: Clarity Idol
pages.text: Dispels rain and storms, restoring clear skies.

pages.title: Tempest Idol
pages.text: Summons a thunderstorm for a time, calling down a darker and more volatile sky.

pages.title: Purity Idol
pages.text: Removes curses from enchanted items when used alongside them, cleansing afflictions such as Binding and Vanishing.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Idols offer direct control over forces that are otherwise difficult to influence, making them valuable tools for both utility and preparation.
